brief: 8 Claude Code patterns that separate hobbyists from operators — concrete examples each.

slots.body: Six concrete patterns that turn casual Claude users into production-grade operators. No theory—just the workflows that ship.
Operators write a CLAUDE.md manifest. Hobbyists re-explain the stack every session.
slots.card1Body: Teams with >3 files or non-obvious architecture decisions that must survive sessions.
slots.card2Body: Context is cheaper than chat. One markdown file eliminates fifty repetitive prompts.

slots.body: Operators wire MCP servers and custom slash commands. Hobbyists stop at default bash and edit.
slots.card1Body: Tasks needing real-time data, external APIs, or specialized validation beyond core IDE tools.
slots.card2Body: Claude without tools is a chatbot. Claude with tools is an autonomous operator.

slots.body: Operators run /test and /review in tight loops. Hobbyists pray the code works after one pass.
slots.card1Body: Any production code where hallucinated imports or logic bugs cost real debugging time.
slots.card2Body: Speed comes from cycles, not single prompts. The loop is the product.

slots.body: Operators commit before every experiment and /compact context before it bleeds. Hobbyists lose hours to rollback.
slots.card1Body: Long refactor sessions where Claude might touch twenty files or overwrite working logic.
slots.card2Body: Treat context like RAM and git like disk. Commit often; compact before swap.

slots.body: Operators enforce JSON schemas and artifact tags. Hobbyists parse prose and pray for valid syntax.
slots.card1Body: Multi-step pipelines where downstream scripts consume Claude output without human cleanup.
slots.card2Body: Unstructured output is a demo. Structured output is infrastructure.

slots.body: Operators spawn architect, coder, and reviewer roles with @mentions. Hobbyists dump everything into one thread.
slots.card1Body: Complex features where design constraints must survive implementation without drift.
slots.card2Body: One brain cannot hold design and debug state. Separate contexts preserve intent.

slots.body: Deploy one pattern today. The gap between hobbyist and operator is one committed workflow.
